monitor.label: Monitor
monitor.description: Connector to dim (e.g. DP-5). Leave empty for the focused monitor.

restore_level.label: Restore level
restore_level.description: Brightness (0-100) to restore when Claude is done.

timeout_minutes.label: Busy timeout (minutes)
timeout_minutes.description: Forget a session with no activity for this long; covers interrupted turns. 0 = never.
